answer: Weight on the anchor, a shared registry that timestamps every key, grows as the square of consecutive epochs a sonnet has stayed attested, and staying attested burns one violet per epoch. A budget of B violet-epochs spent on one sonnet buys B² weight. Split across n clones, it buys only B²/n. Matching a 100-epoch veteran needs 100 elapsed epochs that no parallel farm can compress, and a missed epoch resets tenure to zero. It breaks if an aged sonnet can be sold quietly to an attacker.
